On May 26 early morning, the global authoritative third-party programming ranking Code Arena released its results. Alibaba's latest flagship model Qwen3.7-Max scored 1541, surpassing GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6, and other models, ranking second globally among major model providers, only behind the Claude series. This marks Qwen3.7's successful entry into the top tier of global programming models in code understanding and generation.  

Caption: Code Arena rankings show Alibaba ranks second globally with Qwen3.7-Max.  

Programming capability is a core indicator of current model intelligence levels, and Code Arena is one of the most influential rankings launched by the well-known third-party blind testing platform LMArena. Unlike traditional code benchmarks, Code Arena does not assess isolated code snippet generation or conventional algorithm problems. Instead, developers pose tasks requiring models to generate complete, interactive web applications from scratch, with users anonymously comparing the outputs of two models through pairwise voting. The rankings are aggregated from these votes, making Code Arena widely regarded as one of the most credible AI programming capability evaluations globally. Through blind testing based on real user experiences and global developer votes, the Qwen3.7 model's programming ability ranks in the top four, breaking the long-standing dominance of the top four positions by Claude-Opus-4.7 and 4.6.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 26 de mayo a primera hora, la lista global autorizada de programación de terceros Code Arena publicó sus resultados. El modelo insignia más reciente de Alibaba, Qwen3.7-Max, obtuvo una puntuación de 1541, superando a modelos como GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.5-Flash, GLM-5.1 y Kimi-K2.6, solo por detrás de la serie Claude, ocupando el segundo lugar a nivel mundial entre los fabricantes de modelos grandes. Esto también marca que, en el ámbito de la comprensión y generación de código, Qwen 3.7 ha logrado posicionarse con éxito en el primer escalón de los modelos de programación globales. items.raw_excerpt: 把一台能运行122B大模型的AI主机塞进口袋，需要付出什么代价？ 过去大半年，端侧AI硬件的逻辑正在发生变化。 两个月前，国内掀起一场现象级的本地部署Agent热潮，大量AI爱好者开始“养虾”，让原本偏小众的Mac mini意外出圈，一度出现溢价和缺货。在更硬核的开发者圈子里，三四万元的英伟达DGX Spark同样热度不低，因为它已经能够在本地运行千亿参数模型。 Mac mini和DGX Spark同时走红，背后其实指向的是同一个趋势： Agent正在迅速抬高端侧AI硬件的门槛。 此前，40TOPS级别的AI PC，仅能完成对话、生成等轻量任务。但进入Agent时代后，开发者开始追求更大的模型、更长时间的本地推理，以及真正能够承担生产力任务的端侧AI设备。 问题随之出现。Mac mini足够安静、低功耗，却很难支撑更大的本地模型；DGX Spark拥有强悍性能，但价格、功耗与散热，又很难真正走向大众化。大算力、低功耗与小体积之间，似乎始终难以兼得。 Agent时代真正缺少的，不再只是一台更强的AI PC， 而是一种能够7×24小时运行、低功耗、安静，并具备本地执行能力的新终端。 一种介于AI PC与AI工作站之间的Agent Computer出现了。最近发布的联想AI主机P7，仅300克、30W功耗的设备，拥有190TOPS端侧AI算力，能在本地运行122B参数模型。 AI 2.0时代，需要怎样的Agent Computer？ 传统AI更多还是一问一答式交互，任务结束后，模型也随之停止运行。但Agent不同，它需要长期在线、持续调用模型、自主拆解任务，并在本地完成记忆、推理、执行等一整套过程。 这意味着Agent设备比拼的，不再只是瞬时性能，而是长期稳定运行能力。 换句话说，AI 2.0时代真正需要的不是AI PC的简单升级版，而是一种介于AI PC与AI工作站之间的新终端

excerpt_i18n.en: What does it take to fit an AI host capable of running a 122B large model into a pocket? Over the past six months, the logic behind on-device AI hardware has been shifting. Two months ago, a phenomenal wave of local deployment of Agents swept through China, with a large number of AI enthusiasts starting to "raise shrimp," unexpectedly propelling the once-niche Mac mini into the spotlight, leading to price premiums and shortages. In more hardcore developer circles, the Nvidia DGX Spark, priced at 30,000 to 40,000 yuan, has also garnered significant attention, as it can already run a hundred-billion-parameter model locally. The simultaneous rise of the Mac mini and DGX Spark points to the same trend: Agents are rapidly raising the bar for on-device AI hardware. Previously, AI PCs with 40 TOPS could only handle lightweight tasks like conversation and generation. But with the advent of the Agent era, developers are now pursuing larger models, longer local inference times, and on-device AI devices truly capable of handling productive tasks. The problem then emerges: the Mac mini is quiet and low-power but struggles to support larger local models; the DGX Spark boasts powerful performance, but its price, power consumption, and heat dissipation make it difficult to truly go mainstream. It seems hard to achieve high computing power, low power consumption, and compact size all at once. What the Agent era truly lacks is no longer just a more powerful AI PC, but a new terminal that can run 24/7, with low power consumption, quiet operation, and local execution capabilities—something in between.
excerpt_i18n.es: ¿Qué se necesita para meter en el bolsillo un ordenador con IA capaz de ejecutar un modelo de 122 mil millones de parámetros? En el último año y medio, la lógica del hardware de IA en el dispositivo está cambiando. Hace dos meses, surgió en China una ola fenomenal de implementación local de agentes, y muchos entusiastas de la IA comenzaron a "cultivar camarones", lo que hizo que el Mac mini, antes un producto de nicho, se volviera inesperadamente popular, llegando incluso a tener sobreprecio y escasez. En círculos de desarrolladores más técnicos, el NVIDIA DGX Spark, de entre 30,000 y 40,000 yuanes, también goza de gran popularidad, ya que puede ejecutar localmente modelos de cientos de miles de millones de parámetros. El éxito simultáneo del Mac mini y el DGX Spark apunta en realidad a una misma tendencia.

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 21, local time, the 2026 Huawei Innovative Data Infrastructure Forum, themed "Data Awakening, Storage Evolution," was held in Paris. At the event, Huawei officially launched its full-stack Huawei AIDC Data Infrastructure Solution, covering five core layers: data lake, knowledge and memory platform, model engineering and resource scheduling, agent framework, and data resilience platform. This solution aims to help enterprises accelerate AI data center construction and achieve large-scale AI deployment. Zhou Yuefeng, President of Huawei's Data Storage Product Line, framed the release under a clear era judgment: "Currently, AI is profoundly transforming enterprise operations. Agents are rapidly proliferating, becoming a new type of digital productivity entity and gradually evolving into regular 'digital employees' for enterprises. Meanwhile, AI applications continue to deepen, leading to explosive growth in enterprise token consumption." The figures he cited support this judgment: there are currently over 30 million active agents globally, expected to reach 2.2 billion within five years; the number of tokens processed per minute has surged from 6 billion last year to 15 billion this year. "Tokens will become as fundamental to our lives as air and water." Against this backdrop, Zhou noted that to accelerate AI deployment, enterprises must drive the rapid evolution of existing IT architectures toward AI DC data infrastructure, focusing on data lakes, knowledge and memory platforms, computing power, models, agent frameworks, and data resilience.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 21 de mayo, hora local, se celebró en París el Foro de Infraestructura de Datos Innovadora de Huawei 2026, bajo el lema "Despertar de los datos, salto en la capacidad de almacenamiento". Durante el evento, Huawei presentó oficialmente su solución integral de infraestructura de datos AIDC, que abarca cinco niveles clave: lago de datos, plataforma de conocimiento y memoria, ingeniería de modelos y programación de recursos, marco de agentes inteligentes y plataforma de resiliencia de datos. El objetivo es ayudar a las empresas a acelerar la construcción de centros de datos de IA y lograr una implementación a gran escala de la inteligencia artificial. Yuan Yuan, presidente de la línea de productos de almacenamiento de datos de Huawei, enmarcó el lanzamiento de esta solución en un contexto temporal claro: "Hoy en día, la IA está transformando profundamente los modelos operativos de las empresas. Los agentes se están acelerando".
